decisions.reason: The click-in adapter remains a low-cost, flagship option whose uncertainty has largely resolved, and its carrying cost is low enough to justify keeping the option open.
As a multi-model LED luminaire close to the established core, its option has likely become a stable source of value, so dropping is unlikely.

The server box carries higher software and support costs, but it remains a strategic option in home automation where uncertainty and upside still persist, so management keeps it while monitoring costs.
This luminaire family leverages existing design and distribution capabilities, making its carrying costs low and its resolved option value high enough to retain.
